milestones.title: Formally Enthroned as 14th Dalai Lama in Lhasa
milestones.description: Formally enthroned as the spiritual and temporal leader of Tibet at the Potala Palace in Lhasa.

milestones.title: Decorated for Valor in Sabena Flight 571 Counter-Terrorist Hostage Rescue
milestones.description: Led Sayeret Matkal assault team storming hijacked aircraft at Lod Airport, sustaining a gunshot wound during the successful rescue of 100 passengers.

milestones.title: Became Most Decorated Soldier in Israel Defense Forces History
milestones.description: Awarded the Order of Distinguished Service and four Chief of General Staff citations for valor and covert operations.

milestones.title: Delivered Historic Olive Branch Address to the UN General Assembly
milestones.description: Became the first representative of a non-governmental organization to address a plenary session of the UN General Assembly.

milestones.title: First Female Co-Anchor of Network Evening News Broadcast
milestones.description: Joined Harry Reasoner as co-anchor of ABC Evening News on unprecedented $1 million per year contract.

milestones.title: First Female Correspondent on CBS News' 60 Minutes
milestones.description: Joined Mike Wallace, Morley Safer, Harry Reasoner, and Ed Bradley as the broadcast's first female investigative correspondent.

milestones.title: Delivered First Major UN General Assembly Address on Palestine
milestones.description: Represented Israel at the 39th UN General Assembly debate, establishing a high-profile diplomatic presence.

milestones.title: Founded Oxford University L'Chaim Society
milestones.description: Established the Oxford L'Chaim Society as an official university society attracting prominent student leaders, international scholars, and visiting statesmen.

milestones.title: Launched Sky Television as Founding Executive Chairman
milestones.description: Supervised the launch of Britain's first multi-channel satellite television network for Rupert Murdoch's News International.

milestones.title: Only American Anchor to Broadcast Live from Berlin Wall on Night of Its Fall
milestones.description: Conducted live satellite broadcast from the Brandenburg Gate as East Berliners crossed the border.

milestones.title: Awarded 1989 Nobel Peace Prize for Non-Violent Advocacy
milestones.description: Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in Oslo for his consistent opposition to the use of violence in his struggle for Tibetan autonomy.

milestones.title: Directed Defense Operations for 1991 Operation Desert Storm
milestones.description: Coordinated coalition military campaign liberating Kuwait with minimal coalition casualties, awarded Presidential Medal of Freedom.

milestones.title: Hosted the White House Handshake for 1993 Oslo Accords
milestones.description: Presided over the signing of the Declaration of Principles on the South Lawn between Yitzhak Rabin and Yasser Arafat.

milestones.title: Authored and Enacted the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA)
milestones.description: Landmark federal legislation providing $1.6 billion toward the investigation and prosecution of violent crimes against women.

milestones.title: Signed the 1994 Israel–Jordan Peace Treaty with King Hussein
milestones.description: Concluded historic peace treaty ending 46 years of official war between the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan and the State of Israel.

milestones.title: Awarded 1994 Nobel Peace Prize for the Oslo Accords
milestones.description: Co-awarded the Nobel Peace Prize alongside Shimon Peres and Yasser Arafat in Oslo, Norway.

milestones.title: Awarded 1994 Nobel Peace Prize for Diplomatic Peace Initiatives
milestones.description: Co-awarded the Nobel Peace Prize alongside Yitzhak Rabin and Yasser Arafat.

milestones.title: Co-awarded 1994 Nobel Peace Prize for Historic Middle East Peace Accords
milestones.description: Received Nobel Peace Prize alongside Yitzhak Rabin and Shimon Peres.

milestones.title: Won Lemelson-MIT Student Prize for Haptic Robotic Invention
milestones.description: Awarded $30,000 national collegiate invention award at MIT for creating the PHANToM haptic interface device.

milestones.title: Delivered Landmark 'Women's Rights Are Human Rights' UN Address
milestones.description: Addressed the UN Fourth World Conference on Women in Beijing, establishing a global human rights doctrine.

milestones.title: Elected Youngest Prime Minister in Israeli History
milestones.description: Won the first direct election for Prime Minister of Israel at age 46, becoming the first PM born in Israel after independence.

milestones.title: Signed the Protocol Concerning the Redeployment in Hebron
milestones.description: Concluded the Hebron Protocol transferring civil authority and military control of Area H-1 to the Palestinian National Authority.

milestones.title: Survived 1997 Mossad Fentanyl Inoculation Assassination Attempt
milestones.description: Following diplomatic intervention by King Hussein of Jordan, Israel provided the antidote and released Ahmed Yassin.

milestones.title: Co-brokered the 1998 Good Friday Agreement in Northern Ireland
milestones.description: Concluded historic peace accord ending three decades of The Troubles in Northern Ireland, ratified by referendum.

milestones.title: Piloted the Human Rights Act 1998 into UK Law
milestones.description: Incorporated the European Convention on Human Rights into domestic UK law as Home Secretary.

milestones.title: Published International Bestseller Kosher Sex
milestones.description: Authored globally acclaimed treatise on marital intimacy and relationships, published by Doubleday and translated into 20+ languages.

milestones.title: Led Israeli Delegation at Camp David 2000 Peace Summit
milestones.description: Negotiated comprehensive final status peace proposals alongside US President Bill Clinton and Palestinian Chairman Yasser Arafat.

milestones.title: Presided Over 115 Months of Continuous Peacetime Economic Expansion
milestones.description: Created over 22 million jobs, achieving consecutive federal budget surpluses for the first time in three decades.

milestones.title: Co-Organized and Introduced Oxford Union Address on Children's Rights
milestones.description: Introduced Michael Jackson before an overflow audience at the Oxford Union for a historic address launching the 'Heal the Kids' charitable initiative.

milestones.title: Youngest Nationally Syndicated Columnist in United States at Age 17
milestones.description: Signed national syndication contract with Creators Syndicate while a high school student.

milestones.title: Anchored 25 Continuous Hours of Live Coverage Following 9/11
milestones.description: Anchored ABC News coverage without interruption through the attacks on the World Trade Center and Pentagon.

milestones.title: Implemented the London Congestion Charge Scheme
milestones.description: Pioneered world's largest urban congestion charging zone in central London, cutting traffic by 15% and funding bus transport.

milestones.title: Testified Before US Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations
milestones.description: Confronted US Senators Norm Coleman and Carl Levin in televised hearing rebutting Iraq oil-for-food allegations.

milestones.title: Led Change and Reform List to Majority in 2006 Palestinian Elections
milestones.description: Won 74 of 132 seats in the Palestinian Legislative Council, leading to his appointment as Prime Minister.

milestones.title: Premiered National Television Series Shalom in the Home on TLC
milestones.description: Hosted two seasons of family counseling and conflict resolution broadcast across North America on TLC, winning the National Fatherhood Award.

milestones.title: First Female Speaker of the United States House of Representatives
milestones.description: Became the first woman in American history to wield the Speaker's gavel and stand second in presidential succession.

milestones.title: Awarded US Congressional Gold Medal in Washington, D.C.
milestones.description: Conferred the highest civilian honor bestowed by the United States Congress in recognition of his human rights and interfaith leadership.

milestones.title: Led Yisrael Beiteinu to 15 Knesset Seats in 2009 Elections
milestones.description: Propelled his party to become the third-largest faction in the Knesset, reshaping Israeli coalition politics.

milestones.title: Elected to Fatah Central Committee While Incarcerated
milestones.description: Secured the highest number of votes of any candidate at the 6th Fatah Congress in Bethlehem.

milestones.title: Awarded 2009 Nobel Peace Prize for International Diplomacy
milestones.description: Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for extraordinary efforts to strengthen international diplomacy and cooperation between peoples.

milestones.title: Signed the Affordable Care Act into Federal Law
milestones.description: Enacted the most significant regulatory overhaul of the US healthcare system since Medicare and Medicaid in 1965.

milestones.title: Conducted Over 50,000 On-Air Interviews Across 5 Decades
milestones.description: Completed 25 continuous years hosting Larry King Live on CNN with over 50,000 interview records.

milestones.title: Won Republican Nomination for US Congress in New Jersey's 9th District
milestones.description: Won the primary election to become the certified major-party nominee for the United States House of Representatives in New Jersey's 9th Congressional District.

milestones.title: Secured UN Non-Member Observer State Status for Palestine
milestones.description: Achieved diplomatic milestone with UN General Assembly Resolution 67/19 passing with 138 votes in favor.

milestones.title: Served Three Consecutive Terms as Mayor of New York City
milestones.description: Led New York City for 12 continuous years following 9/11, rebuilding the World Trade Center site and lowering crime rates.

milestones.title: Awarded US Congressional Gold Medal and Presidential Medal of Freedom
milestones.description: One of only nine people in history to receive both the Nobel Peace Prize and the highest two civilian honors of the United States.

milestones.title: Convened US Capitol Hill Panel with Elie Wiesel on Iran Nuclear Agreement
milestones.description: Organized historic public bipartisan briefing in the Dirksen Senate Office Building featuring Nobel laureate Elie Wiesel and US senators on international security.

milestones.title: Won Labour Leadership Election with Record 59.5% Mandate
milestones.description: Elected Leader of the Labour Party with 251,417 votes on the first ballot from 200/1 outsider odds.

milestones.title: Achieved First Vertical Landing of an Orbital Rocket Booster
